description: Stable Halt host for soft live Playwright — must stay on the curated own-threat list (.example TLD).
notes: Prefer this over live phishing TLDs. Workers /api/check uses the same curated list in evaluation/CI.
Override host with PLAYWRIGHT_HALT_HOST only if that host remains on curated-threats.json.
Origin: PLAYWRIGHT_LIVE_BASE_URL or PRODUCTION_HEALTH_URL (https://buusdocst.mtsu.workers.dev). Specs skip when unreachable.
Do not replace with a real-brand phishing URL — .example keeps CI deterministic and non-harmful.
